notes.title: FREE CHALLENGE UPDATE
notes.content:
Greetings, brave adventurers and tiny explorers,
 
 We hope you've been having a great time playing Tinykin so far! 
 
 We have great news for those who have finished the game and are eager for more (unless you’re afraid of hornets, that is).
 Jokes aside, you know how competitive hornets can get, and they'd like to challenge you to race in the [i]Swiftornet[/i]!
 
[previewyoutube=7KsOpffpB9w;full][/previewyoutube]
 
 Look for the friendly hornets [b]Mach[/b] and [b]Dash[/b] with your augmented reality glasses, talk to them and get ready to join the tiny racing buzz!
 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723313/b47e950c99ba75e186e9b50de7a1f832740fc3c7.gif[/img]
 
 [h3]Time Attack Challenges[/h3]
 
 [b][i]Time Attack Challenges[/i][/b] can be unlocked when completing the main quest in each room: Transidor, Sanctar, Foliana, Balnea, Ambrose and Celerion. There are two challenges per room, one shorter than the other, and several medals to earn for each of them!
 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723313/7a2d7cba57b26303f3fff7ca2bf803c46bbcc052.jpg[/img]
 
 You will need to get at least a Bronze Medal on Dash’s short track to unlock Mach’s longer one.
 The race consists of reaching each arrow bubble as fast as possible until you cross the finish-line bubble. In the end, you will teleport back to the corresponding hornet, who'll keep you updated on your progress and rewards!
 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723313/7a9d2f3d16554a6d6e2e2e1c80a0a3693d534cf8.jpg[/img]
 
 You will also find a new hornet in Chrysal Workshop called [b]Legarfald[/b]who's waiting to tell you how cool you look in your new outfits. Oh, right, we almost “forgot” to tell you about those! 😉
 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723313/062e66a7f608bdfb51d4a8dc0c1406deb1aacff3.jpg[/img]
 
 [h3]New Outfits for Milo[/h3]
 For those who have already finished the game, you will find a special gift outfit in Chrysal already waiting for you! In addition, winning two gold medals in each of the six rooms will unlock more exclusive outfits for Milo! 
 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723313/3dfc109e5d3dafdf1ab09d49d2b58a1451060c89.jpg[/img]
 
 There are a couple of secret outfits as well that you will have to discover by completing the challenges and reaching 100% game completion!
 
 You will be able to collect each outfit reward in Chrysal and switch to them in the special Costume tab in the Game Menu.
 
 Remember, [i]you gotta go fast[/i], adventurers!
 
 If you want to learn more about this update, read the patch notes below! 👇
 
 [u][b][h3]v1.1.0 PATCH NOTES[/h3][/b][/u]
 [list]
 [*]Two time attack challenges have been added in six rooms: Transidor, Sanctar, Foliana, Balnea, Ambrose, Celerion.
 [list][*]These challenges become available once the main quest has been completed. 
 [*]The long track is available once you obtain at least the Bronze medal on the short track.[/list]
 [*]Scoreboards have been added to the Game Menu, under Objectives.
 [*]You can now switch between Quests display mode and Challenges display mode by pressing a button.
 [*]The challenges’ screen of each room now displays your personal best time and the standard reference times for each medal.
 [*]Two new hornet NPCs have been added to guide you through the challenges. They can be seen in Chrysal Workshop or in any of the previous rooms once the main quest has been completed. Mach is in charge of the long tracks and Dash is in charge of the short ones.
 [*]New outfits for Milo have been added to the game and to the Outfits tab in the menu.
 [list][*]They can be earned by winning 2 gold medals in a room.[/list][/list]

notes.title: A MAJOR UPDATE (Version 1.0.8) is live now today in Tinykin!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello brave adventurers![/h3]
 
We have seen so much amazing feedback since the official launch of Tinykin and have been working tirelessly to improve the game according to your comments. 
 
[h3]We are thrilled to announce that a MAJOR UPDATE (Version 1.0.8) is live now today in the game![/h3]
 
Without further ado, let’s take a look at what this update offers:
 
[h2][b][u]Quality of Life Improvements:[/u][/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] There's now a Tinykin counter implemented in the game that indicates how many Tinykins are yet to be found. If you’ve been wanting to get the Gotta Catch'em All! Achievement, this will be extremely helpful!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723313/9ba684d8ce669b36fc7648b4871428be461d9430.png[/img]

[*] Chrysal Workshop Button is implemented in the game to help Milo quickly get back to the main map where all rooms connect. This will be helpful when you want to get access to certain maps in a quicker/not manual way. It also helps when you get stuck/clipped in places and are unable to continue the game;

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723313/d6977616ede3d37283d2d4815035450b8b42849f.png[/img]

[*] Widescreen support is now added to the game for you to change the resolutions natively.
[/list]
 
[b][u][h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2][/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed crashes occurring in Balnea, for AMD GPU users;
[*] The broken achievement issues should be fixed now. If you have previously encountered completed achievement issues related to collections, please revisit each room in order to refresh the stats and unlock them;
[*] Chrysal Workshop button allows you to leave situations where previously getting soft-locked;
[*] Fixed the settings issue where they would change back to default after setting them to Medium;
[*] More minor fixes.
[/list]
 
 
We are continuing to apply more updates and changes into the game and constantly collecting your feedback so update the game now and let us know how that works for you! Thank you all for the kind support again and we look forward to discussing the changes with you in our community channels:
 
[list]
[*] [url=https://www.facebook.com/SplashteamDevs/]Facebook[/url]

[/list]
 
See you in the game adventurers!

notes.title: Tinykin is live now on Steam!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]

[quote][h2]Float, surf and jump onto greater heights and adventures. Tinykin is live now on Steam![/h2][/quote]
[h3]Join Milo on his adventure:[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1599020/Tinykin/

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Eh12HKV.gif[/img]

Step into Tinykin and the miniaturized shoes of cosmic explorer Milo in a house that has not aged since the nineties. Float across great distances with a versatile bubble-glider, team up with local tinykins to explore new paths opened by moving gigantic objects, and shake things up with some explosive aid. 

[h3]The biggest tiny house party starts now! Watch the release trailer to get started: 👀[/h3]
[previewyoutube=terVw3jDZeo;full] https://youtu.be/terVw3jDZeo[/previewyoutube]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]To celebrate the release, we are also doing a GIVEAWAY! [/h3]
[url=https://twitter.com/SplashteamDevs/status/1564641792070336519]👉Click to join the GIVEAWAY!👈[/url]

[b]RULES:[/b]
👍Like and retweet this release announcement tweet.
🥳We are giving 5 lucky winners: 1 key to the full Tinykin game each!
⏰You can enter from August 30th to September 5th.
🌏 Open worldwide!

Good luck everyone! We will contact the winners to deliver the keys when the giveaway ends!
[hr][/hr]
[h3]🚨Exploration mission initiated!🚨[/h3]
Calling all adventurers, check out your DAY 1 Agenda here as Milo to embark on a smoother journey!

[b][u]- Gather tinykins to scale new heights, explore new paths and open up possibilities! [/u][/b]
Spot some adorable color-coded critters scattering across the floor? Gather these friendly pals called tinykins and fire up their special abilities to aid you in your operations.

[b]Here’s a handy guide for you to know them better!👇 [/b]

[quote]💗[b]Pink tinykin [/b]- The muscle of the squad, ask them to move blocking objects or carry items to complete missions;

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1rSAyQC.gif[/img][/quote]

[quote]💚[b]Green tinykin[/b] - The ladder of the squad, ask them to stack up and send you to higher grounds;

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UtoNiPS.gif[/img][/quote]

[quote]💙[b]Blue tinykin [/b]- The electrician of the squad, ask them to revive the household devices and brew wonderful results;

[img]https://i.imgur.com/S4dnsQK.gif[/img][/quote]

[quote]❤️[b]Red tinykin[/b] - The bomb of the squad, not happy with what you see in front of you? Ask these hot tempered guys to get rid of them and  jazz up the party with some explosive effects!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IuURJoS.gif[/img][/quote]

[quote]💛[b]Yellow tinykin[/b] - The bridge of the squad, ask them to connect seemingly massive gaps and build a path for fellow pink tinykins to fulfill their missions.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/f6PjaES.gif[/img][/quote]

[u][b]- Utilize and upgrade Milo’s versatile capabilities to reach new platforms and travel across great distances![/b][/u]
Milo might have been shrunk down in size, but his versatile capabilities clearly have not downgraded.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ix3cQvz.gif[/img]

[b]Surf [/b]- reach your destination faster with a soapboard. Slide on the edges of the furniture or traverse across the entire room on a zipline, speed up your adventure with some smooth rides.
[b]Glide[/b] - Got stuck in a lone island or up on the top of the bookshelf? Float your way down or across gracefully to areas far away. 
[b]Jump[/b] - Milo can reach certain heights even without the help of tinykins.

[b][u]- Gather pollen for amazing rewards![/u][/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RM6XwQD.gif[/img]
A challenging journey requests you to travel far and luckily you can collect some dazzling treasure on the way. Gather pollen from the top of a massive lamp, deep in a hidden gap or up above the top kitchen shelf. Sikaru, one of the local residents, will happily offer you a new bubble for your glider once you've collected all the pollen count he requested.

[b][u]- Interact with locals to unravel the secrets of the house[/u][/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qgAGOhW.gif[/img]

After rediscovering Earth, mankind’s long-lost homeworld, Milo finds himself stuck in a massive house that hasn’t aged since the nineties. Curiouser and curiouser, the local insect population are remarkably sapient and chatty. Inspect the incidents and collect your clues through conversations with the locals and fulfilling their side quests. Help them unravel the secrets of the house, bring music back to the living room and scrub up the dark corners of the bathroom as you search for a way to return Milo to his ship - and ideally at the right size!

[hr][/hr]

Are you ready for the adventure now? Join our communities to participate in interactive events with great rewards, share your feedback on the game with devs and talk to other explorers for clues and tips!

notes.title: Try Tinykin's Switch demo now and pre-order!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello adventurers![/h3]

The biggest tiny house party is striding into the final weeks before the grand opening. 

[h2]Tinykin, our brand new adventure platformer is now available to pre-order, with a new demo on Switch LIVE now![/h2]

[h3][url=tinykingame.com]👉Pre-order Now!👈[/url][/h3]

[b]This August 30th, adventurers on all platforms (including Xbox & PC Game Pass) can step into the miniaturized shoes of Milo. [/b]After rediscovering Earth, mankind’s long-lost homeworld, his exploration mission goes awry as he finds himself shrunk down to the size of a bug, and the house he’s stuck in hasn’t aged since the nineties. Curiouser and curiouser, the local insect population are remarkably sapient and chatty. Take a peek at the mysteries to be solved in the trailer below.

[h3]Watch the trailer now:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=5kQOm1HXyQk;full][/previewyoutube]

Every room is its own biome, populated by strange creatures and civilizations. Help them unravel the secrets of the house, bring music back to the living room and scrub up the dark corners of the bathroom as you search for a way to return Milo to his ship - and ideally at the right size!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/eVoFMjY.jpg[/img]

It’s a big job, but Milo won’t be alone. Most locals are eager to lend a hand, but none moreso than the mysterious Tinykin. These strange critters hatch fully formed and excited to help. Gather a huge swarm of color-coded pals and utilize their special powers. Scale new heights as they form ladders, explore new paths opened by moving gigantic objects, and shake things up with some explosive aid, for when problems just need to be blown to bits.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QDu1tuw.jpg[/img]

Milo is a pretty handy too, equipped with a versatile bubble-glider that lets him float across great distances, adding to his already prodigious jumps. Upgrade it further to traverse huge chasms. He’s also picked up some tricks from the locals, like riding a bar of soap like a surfboard, sliding and grinding across any flat surface or edge. Spot a spider-web? Ride that rail, direct to new adventures!

[hr][/hr]

As usual, join our social media channels now to chat with our team! We will also be holding a series of GIVEAWAY before the release date. 👀

notes.title: Tinykin is coming to Steam on August 30th, 2022. Wishlist now!
notes.content:
[h3]Calling all adventurers, we have [b]BIG[/b] news![/h3]

[quote][h2]Tinykin is coming to Steam on August 30th, 2022![/h2][/quote]

[h3]To celebrate, Milo invites you to the biggest little house party in this Release Date Announcement Trailer! He is proud to be featured at the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4WWYDvAQMrg]Future Games Show[/url] now.[/h3]

[h3]🔻Watch the Release Date Announcement Trailer now!🔻 [/h3]
[previewyoutube=N-zvRSDnm0o;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]🔻Don’t forget to WISHLIST the game and try out the free DEMO that is available now on the page!🔻[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1599020/Tinykin/

[hr][/hr]
As we stride into the release date countdown months officially, we hope you are looking forward to all the exhilarating journey and fun encounters in Tinykin like we are!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NXd2kY6.gif[/img]

[b]Tinykin is an innovative 3D puzzle platformer where you play as an intergalactic astronaut named Milo. [/b]Milo arrives on Earth only to find out that he becomes a tiny figure in a huge house where not a day has passed since 1991! Explore the massive, miniature environments of the house as Milo, with each room populated by its own strange cultures and presenting fresh problems to pick through.

Luckily, he has got some great companions and reliable mates. Team up with the mysterious tinykin and use their unique powers to complete missions, solve puzzles, retrieve valuable items and return home!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/iUIql0A.gif[/img]

You can probably tell by the game’s name that those tiny creatures are very important in your adventure and you are absolutely right! Build up a swarm of these strange new friends, and have them move massive objects, build ladders, blast open sealed passages and more for you.

[h3]Let’s greet them properly, shall we? While alone they rarely pose a threat, in great numbers Tinykin’s power is exemplary.[/h3]

[quote][h3]🔻The purple tinykin🔻[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jPsrmiu.gif[/img]

They are extremely powerful despite their small stature. Solicit their help when you need to do some heavy lifting.[/quote]

[quote][h3]🔻The green tinykin🔻[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/p8Gnec8.gif[/img]

They are extremely resourceful when reaching daring new heights. Gather a bigger team of the green tinykin and you can breathe the air up top![/quote]

[quote][h3]🔻The blue tinykin🔻[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4Gh6O6O.gif[/img]

Watch out and stand away from the blue tinykin, unless you want to take the risk of getting an electric shock! When working with them properly, you can restore some crucial appliances that grant you the entrance to valuable resources.[/quote]

[quote][h3]🔻The red tinykin🔻[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/x4TqQxb.gif[/img]

And don’t forget to befriend this nice little guy in red. He may look like an adorable bomb and have an immensely fiery temper, but he means no harm.[/quote]

[hr][/hr]

That’s all for today, if you’d like to meet more local residents in Tinykin, familiarize yourself with the missions and get a deeper peak at the story, don’t forget to check out our previous Devlog [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1599020/view/3117055056357309632]here[/url]!

Join our social media channels and count down with us! We would appreciate great feedback, ideas or just happy screams if you cannot wait already!

notes.title: Tinykin Devlog: Missions and storylines
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

It’s time for another Tinykin devlog where we show and tell you more about our upcoming game and all the tiny bits and pieces we think you’ll enjoy knowing!

In this episode, Romain and Marie will talk about Tinykin’s storylines and missions. They will also give you a little tour around the house and introduce you to some of the inhabitants Milo will encounter on his journey. So without further ado, let’s dive straight into it!

[h1][b]Watch the Devlog[/b][/h1]
[previewyoutube=9YVlrPvssCI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Meet the locals![/h1]
In Tinykin, each room of the house represents its own town with unique inhabitants, atmosphere, culture and stories to tell. You can also interact and talk to every character you see! Here are just a few of the local townsfolk you’ll meet in the game.

    [tr]
        [td][h3][b]Ants[/b][/h3]
[i]The small guys[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723313/e01292015f05eb22127e76aa8246fae5bfddfa17.gif[/img][/td]
        [td]Ants are a very practical labour force of the house with little social mobility. You can meet them at the Cardboard-box Church that can be found in the Living Room.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
       [td][h3][b]Dragonflies[/b][/h3]
[i]Alien looking pious[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723313/b707ad7fd206765e43d836c63fc8fad2bc315aa7.gif[/img][/td]
        [td]Dragonflies represent more of a high-society religious commune than ants. 
They pray to Ardwin, a giant who lived in the house many years ago. As you move through the house, you'll find out more about Ardwin and his family, and where they all went.
[/td]
    [/tr]  
[tr]
        [td][h3][b]Shieldbugs[/b][/h3]
[i]Their non-menacing look and lack of weapons make them appear all the more friendly.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723313/5bb01175ca964c12b06250065d85be3909a23774.gif[/img][/td]
        [td]Pied shieldbugs are the insects most able to receive the signal of the tune played by Ardwin’s old attic music player. They can hear it when other species can’t. They mistake it for a message from their god.[/td]
    [/tr]
[tr]
        [td][h3][b]Dung-beetles[/b][/h3]
[i]The clean and smelly cuties.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723313/f5c0fabcaa40179e3dbc0e767122099495b4c72a.gif[/img][/td]
        [td]Dung-beetles could be found in the Bathroom. This is also a local community of insects that have sabotaged the festival in a neighboring town. Milo will have to save the festival and restore peace to get one step closer to returning home.  [/td][/tr]

[h1][b]Exploring the house[/b][/h1]
To help Milo get home, you have to assemble a mysterious travel machine, the parts of which have been scattered and hidden around the house. In order to get one of them, you’ll need to lend a helping hand to the local townsfolk in need and solve a difficult task. Let’s take a look at one of the new rooms that we haven’t shown before and talk more about one of these missions.

[h1][b]Save the Foam Festival in the Bathroom[/b][/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hyDTuDN.jpg[/img]

The Bathroom is one of many rooms that you’ll venture on finding parts of the machine. This is home to the community of dung-beetles who have found themselves in the predicament of the foam festival. If you’re to help the insects in need, the mayor of the town will hand over one of the components for the travel machine and you’ll be able to continue your journey through the house. 

In order to do that, try to find your way to the very top of the shelf! Look around and collect as many tinykin as possible. Remember, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1599020/view/2963920750896762629]they differentiate by colour and can help you overcome different obstacles.[/url] Once you’ve made it to the top, push the bubbles and become the local hero! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lH7F2Yj.gif[/img]

But that’s not all. Each room is full of additional side quests that Milo can complete. For example In the Living Room, Milo can save an ant trapped inside a piano, or prove the existence of a monster under the TV.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JZxmjIO.png[/img]

You’ll also meet characters who travel between towns, like Sikaru - the wandering winemaker, who needs pollen from every room to build a winery. Or a postal service that will need Milo’s help on delivering letters around the house! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tEEERyO.gif[/img]

Once you unlock a new room in the house, you can always come back to them later to do more missions. Some quests only become available on your second visit! 
     
And that’s all we have for you today! We hope you’ll enjoy meeting every character and discovering hidden stories in the world of Tinykin. Next time we’ll talk more about the game's music, voices and sound design, so we look forward to seeing you again!

[h1][b]Wishlist and follow Tinykin[/b][/h1]
Make sure to wishlist the game now and follow us on social media to stay up to date with all the announcements! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1599020/Tinykin/

[/list]

notes.title: Tinykin is coming out Summer 2022! Watch the new gameplay deep-dive
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Did you have a chance to check todays’ [b]tinyBuild Connect[/b] episode and see our newest gameplay deep-dive video? If not, don’t panic! We’ll walk you through it straight away!

[previewyoutube=KslV13CJjEU;full][/previewyoutube]

In Tinykin you play as Milo – an intergalactic scientist looking for Earth but accidentally found himself in a large house frozen in the 1990s’. While trying to figure out what has happened here, Milo encounters small creatures called tinykin who are willing to help him on his quest of finding the way back home. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zoay2ez.gif[/img]

Tinykin is a puzzle-platformer game that features a lot of exploration. And you won’t be able to find your way around the house without the help of tinykin. This means you’ll need to look around and collect hundreds of them! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dsIOBgX.gif[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/6l4Q36V.gif[/img]

Tinykin differentiate by colors and can be used to expand Milo’s abilities. For example, the pink tinykin are stronger than Milo and can lift objects bigger than him. On the other hand, you have green tinykin who can stand on top of each other, letting you reach higher places. The more tinykin you have, the more they and you can do. Take your time and look around the house to find more of these little fellas to join your team!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/R3VgBFg.gif[/img]

The house itself is huge! Use Milo’s abilities (like a tiny soap skateboard!) to get around it, look out for shortcuts, and don’t forget to call for tinykin’s help when needed.

Talk to local insects, assist them with their needs in exchange for abilities upgrades and explore the house to find the details of a mysterious machine that will eventually help you get back home.

And that’s everything we’ve got for today. We will be sharing more news and updates about the game in the near future! Please let us know what you think about the game in the comments below.

Make sure to wishlist the game now and follow us on social media to stay up to date with all the announcements!
